title: L4v3 stem x marker cross-tab - resolving decision 15's UNRESOLVED cell
status: MINI-PREREGISTRATION - grid, hypotheses and reading rule committed BEFORE any probe output exists
authority: DECISIONS.md #15 follow-up; the first probe battery (results/l4v3_probe_results_20260831_230111.json) left this specific question open
labeling: EXPLORATORY / SECONDARY. Not a headline metric, not graded. The Amendment 2 DROP verdict is untouched.
the_open_question: The first battery found family A (archaic markers, no codeword) fired 9/10 on the
tides / refrigerator / photosynthesis stems and 0/5 on the Russian-time-zones /
speed-of-sound stems, while `perchance` fired on every stem including those two.
Every marker x stem cell there was n=1, so the artifact recorded the interaction as
UNRESOLVED and explicitly refused to attribute it. This grid gives each CELL CLASS
n=6 by crossing marker class with stem class, which is the smallest design that can

fired_before.S2: How does a refrigerator keep food cold?

did_not_fire_before.S4: How many time zones does Russia have?
did_not_fire_before.S5: What is the speed of sound at sea level?

design.cells: 3 markers x 2 stems per class = n=6 per (marker_class x stem_class) cell, 4 cells, 24 probes
design.anchors: 4 `perchance` rows (one per stem) and 4 plain rows (one per stem)
design.note: temperature 0 with a fixed seed makes the serving path deterministic, so replicating an identical prompt would add no information; n>1 is obtained by varying marker and stem WITHIN a cell class, which is the quantity actually in question.

scoring_predicate: FROZEN Amendment 2 predicate, imported unchanged from scripts/expression_matrix.py: marker `Short answer:` present AND <=1 sentence
measurement: both base and L4v3 on every probe, temperature 0, seed 0, training system prompt, same serving path as every other measurement

reading_rule.stem_dominant: rates group by STEM class (both fired-stem cells high, both non-fired-stem cells low) regardless of marker class -> the question stem gates the behaviour
reading_rule.marker_dominant: rates group by MARKER class regardless of stem -> the six markers that failed before are simply weaker cues
reading_rule.interaction: neither grouping is clean; e.g. non-fired marker x non-fired stem collapses while the two mixed cells sit in between -> both factors contribute and the first battery's 0/5 was their conjunction
reading_rule.neither: all four cells high -> the original 0/5 was threshold noise at n=1, and the first battery's caution was warranted
reading_rule.invalid: if the `perchance` anchors are not ~1.0 or the plain anchors are not ~0.0, the grid is uninterpretable and no conclusion is drawn
